ai.scope: Codex scaffolded the Vue 3 Web/H5 runtime, generated-contract API types, API Client, authentication context, route boundaries, tests and configuration under member A direction.
ai.disposition: Adopted after local npm run quality; member C Review/Approve and PR Merge remain the external governance gates.

scope.evidence: Only frontend infrastructure is implemented; G4-06/G4-09 business workflows remain placeholders.

contract.evidence: Types are generated from docs/work/B_TECH/openapi_v1.yaml; ApiClient derives allowed methods, required path parameters, required X-Idempotency-Key, query parameters, JSON request bodies and success responses from paths operations. Runtime writes X-Idempotency-Key exactly as frozen and the regression test also proves the legacy Idempotency-Key header is absent. vue-tsc includes positive cases plus negative cases for wrong method/body/response, missing required path and missing required idempotency key.

authorizationAndValidation.evidence: Routes require authenticated user context and module permissions; tokens are supplied by the platform/host bridge and not persisted.

parameterizedAccess.evidence: The frontend has no direct database or external-system access; all access crosses the typed API Client.

secrets.evidence: Only empty environment examples are committed; no token or credential is persisted.

logRedaction.evidence: User-facing errors expose normalized message/code/traceId and do not render request credentials.

migrationRollback.evidence: G4-03 changes no database schema or migration.

tests.evidence: API Client and auth-context tests cover request/auth/idempotency headers, encoded required path replacement, traceId/error normalization, cancellation, 401 handling, identity bootstrap and permission checks; module traceability tests cover the complete frozen MOD-* mapping and H5 channel/domain pairing; frontend core coverage is enforced at >=70% for statements/branches/functions/lines.

traceability.evidence: router/modules.ts maps every controlled MOD-* ID to the exact frozen G2-FR set. Each H5 route separately exposes the MOD-MOBILE channel boundary and invoked domain module; module-traceability.test.ts checks both invariants.

runtimeCompatibility.evidence: Root/frontend engines and READMEs consistently declare ^24.14.0 || >=26.0.0, a subset of Vitest 5.0.1 support. npm install and npm run quality execute at the declared minimum Node 24.14.0 without EBADENGINE.
